title: Customer Inquiries, Vehicle Pricing & Stock: Present Simple
description: Essential English for answering foreign dealer inquiries about truck prices, models in stock, and basic lead times.
learning_objectives: Ask and answer basic customer questions about vehicle availability
Use correct question word order with 'How much' and 'How many'
Eliminate Czech preposition and word order transfer in sales inquiries

questions.prompt: How much _____ a standard 6x6 Tatra Phoenix chassis cost under EXW terms?

explanations.correct: Singular subject 'chassis' with main action verb 'cost' requires auxiliary 'does'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'is' cannot be used with base verb 'cost'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Kolik stojí...?'. In English questions with verbs, use 'How much does [subject] cost?'.

questions.prompt: How many 8x8 military trucks _____ currently available in factory stock?

explanations.correct: 'How many trucks' is plural and asks about existence, taking 'are'.
explanations.wrong_D: 'have' does not match the existence structure.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Kolik nákladních vozů je skladem?'. Plural subject requires 'are'.

questions.prompt: Our sales department _____ technical datasheets in English and German.

explanations.correct: Singular corporate subject 'Our sales department' takes 'provides' with singular '-s'.
explanations.wrong_D: Participle alone cannot be finite verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Naše obchodní oddělení poskytuje'. Remember singular department takes '-s' in English.

questions.prompt: When _____ the customer need the final commercial invoice?

explanations.correct: Singular subject 'the customer' requires auxiliary 'does' in Present Simple questions.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Kdy zákazník potřebuje...?'. In English: 'When does the customer need...?'.

questions.prompt: The client _____ not want the standard manual transmission; they prefer automatic.

explanations.correct: Singular subject 'The client' takes 'does not want'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Zákazník nechce'. Use 'does not want', never *is not want*.

questions.prompt: _____ you send us your company VAT number before we prepare the quotation?

explanations.correct: Modal 'Can' expresses a polite commercial request ('Can you send us...?').
explanations.wrong_B: 'Do you send' asks about habitual routine, not a request.

questions.cz_learning_point: In commercial email requests, start with 'Can you send us...' or 'Could you please send us...'.

questions.prompt: All export prices in this price list _____ valid until the end of November.
questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Všechny exportní ceny jsou platné'. 'Prices' is plural $ightarrow$ 'are valid'.

questions.prompt: The Australian mining buyer _____ five Phoenix dump trucks every quarter.

explanations.correct: Singular subject 'The buyer' requires 3rd person singular 'buys'.
explanations.wrong_D: Participle alone cannot be main verb.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Australský těžař kupuje'. Add '-s' to third person singular: 'buys'.

questions.prompt: Is the spare parts catalog available _____ our online dealer portal?

explanations.correct: Websites, portals, and digital platforms always take the preposition 'on' ('on our portal').
explanations.wrong_A: 'at' is used for physical locations or specific email addresses.
explanations.wrong_C: Czechs often say *in the portal* translated from 'v portálu'. English requires 'on the portal'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czechs say 'v portálu / na internetu'. In English, always use 'on our website / on the dealer portal'.

questions.prompt: We _____ have these specific all-terrain tires in stock today.

explanations.correct: Subject 'We' takes 'don't have' in Present Simple.
explanations.wrong_D: 'haven't' as main verb negation without 'got' is non-standard in modern commercial English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Nemáme skladem'. In English, say 'We don't have in stock'.
